claim: Blood's busiest maps sequence their wiring in time, not only in connection: E1M3 has 83 live chains with a waiting step (a listener with a wait time) among 212, E2M5 76 of 128, E1M4 68 of 151, against a campaign median of 16 timed of 47 chains. Chains are shallow everywhere (median deepest 4, at most 8, in E1M3); the complexity is in how many relay through another object (median 12, E1M4 and E2M5 85) and in the waits. Gravesend as built on 2026-11-26 has 149 live chains, 47 relayed, deepest 5, but only 21 with a wait.
evidence: knowledge/blood/findings/probes/mechanism_chain_profile.py over the 43 campaign maps (2026-11-26): live (not silent) chains of bloodmap.wiring.chains; relayed = depth 2 or more; timed = a step whose receiver has a wait; widest = most steps in one chain (E3M1 178). Gravesend from its blood-city-current.MAP the same day
use: When a place should feel alive as the player walks, plan the waits and the order as much as the connections; compare a built map with the probe.

checked.how: Ran probes/mechanism_chain_profile.py: campaign median chains 47, relayed 12 (max 85 E1M4, E2M5), deepest 4 (max 8 E1M3), timed 16 (E1M3 83 of 212, E2M5 76 of 128, E1M4 68 of 151), widest 29 (max 178 E3M1); blood-city-current.MAP 149 chains, 47 relayed, deepest 5, 21 timed, widest 162.
